text:
mira: Quick idea — for role-affinity routing telemetry we should sample differently per-tenant to avoid quota spikes and noisy signals. Thoughts?

jon: Agree. Main risk is inflating dashboard counts and paging SRE. We should default very low but allow per-tenant overrides.

sam: Adaptive sampling could help — bump sample rate when error or latency percentiles exceed thresholds.

kevin: Also want a debug-mode toggle to capture full traces for a tiny subset of requests (enterprise only). Must be gated by consent and audit logging.

mira: Draft config snippet:```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.01   # global default sample fraction
  per_tenant_overrides:
    tenant_123: 0.10
  adaptive_rules:
    - metric: p99_latency_ms
      threshold: 500
      sample_when_triggered: 0.2
  debug_allowlist: ["tenant_123"]
```

product-lead: Keep UX impact minimal. The console should surface the "effective" sampling rate next to the route and role charts so PMs can interpret metrics. Default global 0.01 seems reasonable.

jon: API idea: add a new endpoint PATCH /v1/telemetry/sampling that accepts a small rule DSL. Example body: ```json
{ "target": "tenant:tenant_123", "sample": 0.1 }
``` This keeps mutating rules simple.

mira: Important privacy note — sampled payloads must redact or hash tenant identifiers and strip full prompt text unless explicitly opt-in. Add redaction pipeline entry.

dev-bot: feature-flag check — "role_affinity_sampling" is currently off in prod. :eyes:

sam: UX ask — console should show sampling change history (who changed rate, when) and expected change in token counts. That will help sales & CS.

kevin: Also propose tier-aware defaults: self-serve 0.005, growth 0.02, enterprise 0.1. Allows better observability for paid customers while protecting infra.

mira: Rollout plan suggestion: enable for 5% of tenants as a canary with telemetry-only mode (no dashboard substitution) for 2 weeks, then gradually expand.

jon: I'll open a PR for the API and add unit tests for rule parsing. Assigning tasks: @mira draft the spec, @sam update dashboards mockups, @kevin add rollout/ops playbook.

mira: Thanks — I'll draft the spec today and include the PII redaction checklist.

product-lead: Love this. Please include a short blurb for customer-facing docs explaining sampling semantics and billing implications.

mira: noted. Will include docs + console copy.

jon: cool — next sync we can go over the API contract.

kevin: one more: include a lightweight simulator endpoint so we can show projected token counts for a tenant at different sampling settings. Could be /v1/telemetry/sampling/simulate.

sam: +1 to simulator, will make dashboard adoption easier.

mira: ok closing the thread — PRs incoming.
